parameters.name: operation
parameters.description:
The default value is FIND_BY_DEFAULT.
If the 'operation' parameter is provided then the value must be one of the following values: [FIND_BY_DEFAULT, FIND_NEWER_BY_TIME, FIND_OLDER_BY_TIME].

parameters.name: time
parameters.description:
UTC milliseconds from the epoch of 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.
 The 'time' parameter will be ignored if the operation is FIND_BY_DEFAULT.
 The 'time' parameter is required if the operation is FIND_NEWER_BY_TIME or FIND_OLDER_BY_TIME.

200.description: Retrieve the list of messages sent to the device

get.description:
Returns a single Message for the specified identifier.

Notifications sent with an RTF body will have the content available as an attachment in the 'attachments' section of the response. The attachment content should be downloaded with the [Download attachment](/reference/ebs-daa-get-attachment) endpoint.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Message. The identifier can take one of two formats: 
1. The 'messageId' returned on a message object when retrieved via the API.
2. A concatenated ID from the push notification payload.

**Important Note:** The 'messageId' from the push notification payload will take the form '[contactID]_[notificationID]'. When using this concatenated ID, you must pass through the entire string value. The response will return the underlying message ID, which should then be used for future operations on the message resource.

200.description: Retrieves the message matching the provided Message ID
